**Diagnostics** (helps a lot)
Click "Run diagnostics" in the same section and reload when it asks. Then rename
`World of Warcraft\_forever_\WTF\Account\<your account>\SavedVariables\QuestLadder.lua` to `QuestLadder.txt`
and drag it into this box. It holds your Quest Ladder settings and what the add-on saw (quests, bags, where you were), with no passwords or account details.
